questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Current I=ε/(R+r)=(6) A। terminal V=IR=2×(6)=ε−Ir; emf-এর সমান নয় under load।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Mass 6 kg speed 6 m/s, stationary mass 12 kg-এ লেগে একসঙ্গে চলে। final speed কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। External impulse negligible; momentum (6)·6=((6)+2×(6))v⇒v=2। kinetic energy conserved নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: String length 1 m, wave speed 220 m/s। third harmonic frequency কত Hz?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Both ends fixed: fn=nmode v/(2L)। third harmonic=3·20×(11)/2=30×(11); parameter (11) harmonic index নয়।

questions.question_bn: AC voltage v(t)=4sinωt V। resistive R=2Ω। average power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Peak (4), rms=(4)/√2। P=Vrms²/R=((4)²/2)/2=(4)²/4; peak-squared power double হয়।

questions.question_bn: Cell emf 8 V ও internal r=2Ω। variable external R-এ maximum delivered power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। P=ε²R/(R+r)²; maximum R=r। Pmax=ε²/(4r)=(8)²/8; total circuit power নয়।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic saturated hydrocarbon carbon count 5, C12,H1। molar mass কত g/mol?

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=30, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=28। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। Shell includes l=0…(28)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(28)²। electron capacity 2×(28)², orbitals নয়।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 22×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (22)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((22)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 32k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(12)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=81×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((9)²×10⁻⁹)=(9)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 19 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। FinalO₂=(3/2)(19)। initial gas (19), increase=(3/2)(19)−(19)=(19)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Cell E=0.50 V,nₑ=2,extent 15 mol reaction। F96500C/mol। ΔG কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। ΔG=−extent·(15)ₑFE=−(15)·2·96500·0.5 J=−96.5nkJ। spontaneouspositive EnegativeG।

questions.question_bn: At25°C,[OH⁻]=12×10⁻³M strong base। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। pOH=3−logn, pH=14−pOH=11+logn। water temperature 25°C থেকে p Kw14 ব্যবহার।

questions.question_bn: Molten NaCl electrolysis,total charge 11F। Cl₂moles কত?

questions.question_bn: Atomic number 19, charge 3+। electron count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Neutral electron=Z। cation 3+ means তিন electron lost: Ne=Z−3=(9)+7; proton unchanged।

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 70g,dry mass 56g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(7)/(10×(7))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: Gas mixture 15 mol N₂,2 mol O₂; total pressure 3atm। O₂ partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Dalton partial Poxygen=xo₂Ptotal=[2/((15)+2)]·3=6/((15)+2)atm। mole fraction relevant, mass fraction নয়।

questions.question_bn: Neutral closed-shell formula C9H17N। IHD কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Nitrogen formula IHD=(2C+2+N−H)/2। [2((7)+2)+2+1−(2×(7)+3)]/2=2। halogens থাকলে H equivalent কমাতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=5M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(5)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((5)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: Ethanoicacid NaHCO₃-এ কোন gas দেয়?

questions.question_bn: Buffer HA/A⁻, p Ka=4। [A⁻]/[HA]=3। pH কোনটি?

questions.question_bn: 1600 mL0.20MNaOH; MNaOH 40g/mol। solutemass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Volume 0.1nL,moles 0.20·0.1×(16)=0.02×(16)। massmoles×40=0.8ng; mL→Lconversion দরকার।
